title: Per-put fence adds one keeper renewal round trip per put
notes: upload() used to fence once per upload and now fences before each put (init, then segment). Each fence asks the keeper to renew the job's lease, so a segment upload makes two renewal round trips where it made one. Doing the fence once per upload and checking it against a fresh clock before each put would not do: a put can now outlast a lease, so the second put needs a fresh fence. The cost is small and the choice is sound. Closed at the pivot: Rule 17: says nothing a viewer or operator would notice (a test's strength, a refactor, tooling or an internal cost). Reopen with the effect someone sees and its evidence.
